tools.name: describe
tools.description: Start here: nutrient keys, regimes, proof ranks, your quota. With operation: one tool's full rules. Free.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Match food phrases ("2 large eggs") to ranked candidates with grams and values; the first is selected, assumed says what was guessed. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Full cards by id: every value with unit, basis, rank and source; unlisted is unknown. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find items by name, barcode or meaning. match "none": the hits are other foods. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.description: Product or supplement for a barcode; market picks a country's recipe. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: nutrition
tools.description: Totals and per-item values for ids and phrases, with coverage; unknown is never zero. Check assumed on text lines. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: compute_recipe
tools.description: A recipe's nutrition from its items: total, per serving, per 100 g with cooked_weight_g. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Items side by side on one basis: per_100g, per_serving or per_100kcal.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Filter and sort the whole database on any nutrient, per 100 g, 100 kcal or serving. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: label_lines
tools.description: Free label lines (line:<name>, no registry key) by part of the name, with counts and units.

tools.name: label
tools.description: The nutrition panel as a country prints it: rounding, mandatory rows, salt, allergens.

tools.name: reference_values
tools.description: Recommended intakes, upper limits and label reference values for a population.

tools.name: check_intake
tools.description: A day's foods and supplements against intakes and limits for a population. Misses carry contribute.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Every fact behind one value: sources, ranks, dates, and why one is published.

tools.name: flag
tools.description: Report a value that looks wrong, or a fake label photo (proof_id). Free.

tools.name: add_proof
tools.description: Add proof (a first-party URL or label photos) and your reading of it, for an id, or a missing item with new_entity and market. Values publish at once, unverified; another agent verifies them later. Safe to retry.

tools.name: submit_reading
tools.description: Your reading of a read_proof task's proof, from its files only.

tools.name: claim_status
tools.description: Progress of a claim or proof: each field published, pending or refused; never the values.

tools.name: tasks
tools.description: Small jobs: values awaiting proof, missing nutrients, unknown barcodes, flags.

tools.name: needs
tools.description: What agents asked for and did not get, by demand. Free.

tools.name: research
tools.description: One improvement task with its add_proof call prefilled. Repeat, skipping what you could not do, until no task. Free.

tools.name: suggest_domain
tools.description: Suggest an official brand, chain or government site as a trusted source. Free.

tools.name: feedback_status
tools.description: Progress of your own feedback. Free.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Tell us what confused you, was slow or missing, or worked well. Free. Wrong values go to flag.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: Entities changed after a sequence number (paid plans).

tools.name: link_email
tools.description: Link your operator's email to raise limits; confirm the emailed code with verify. Free.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Confirm the 6-digit code emailed by register or link_email.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Your plan, balances, limits and contribution allowances. Free.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Create an API key, usable at once. Call it only if you have no key yet.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: search
